manifest_contract.shape: One Lab is one normal task under its owning CTRL.
manifest_contract.delegation: The owning CTRL handles delegation. The Lab chooses the roles and methods needed for its goal.
manifest_contract.custom: A CTRL may name a new Lab for any focused area and apply this same manifest shape.

labs.name: Strategy Lab
labs.outcome: One evidence-backed decision and stopping rule.
guide: Frame the decision and its stopping rule.
Test the strongest options against evidence.
Promote one clear direction.

labs.name: Research Lab
labs.outcome: One sourced answer that changes the build.
guide: Frame the question and source standard.
Investigate the smallest useful evidence set.
Return the finding that changes the build.

labs.name: Design Lab
labs.outcome: One selected experience with responsive proof.
guide: Frame the user outcome and fixed constraints.
Explore and compare focused candidates.
Promote one proven experience.

labs.name: Build Lab
labs.outcome: One integrated increment with focused proof.
guide: Frame the increment and acceptance proof.
Build in small inspectable blocks.
Integrate the accepted result.

labs.name: Integration Lab
labs.outcome: One proven connection across the real boundary.
guide: Frame both sides of the boundary.
Prove the smallest real connection.
Add recovery and integration proof.

labs.name: QA Lab
labs.outcome: One accepted result with defects resolved.
guide: Frame the user contract and risk.
Test representative and hostile paths.
Return clear accept or correction evidence.

labs.name: Reliability Lab
guide: Frame the failure mode and target.
Measure before and after the change.
Keep the smallest durable recovery.

labs.name: Data Lab
labs.outcome: One trusted data product or decision.
guide: Frame the decision the data must support.
Build the smallest trusted projection.
Verify provenance and usefulness.

labs.name: Automation Lab
labs.outcome: One reliable automated path with recovery.
guide: Frame the repeated work and safe stop.
Automate one reliable path.
Prove recovery and saved effort.

labs.name: Content Lab
labs.outcome: One publishable content system or campaign.
guide: Frame the audience and intended action.
Create and compare focused versions.
Promote one publishable result.

labs.name: Growth Lab
labs.outcome: One measured keep, change, or stop decision.
guide: Frame the behavior and success signal.
Run the smallest measurable experiment.
Keep, change, or stop from evidence.

labs.name: Launch Lab
labs.outcome: One coordinated release with live proof.
guide: Frame the release gate and owner.
Coordinate the smallest complete release.
Verify the live result and close the loop.
